scope: Unvalidated conceptual screening, not measured AA performance
geometry: Four parametric solid concepts; watertight STL and consistent winding required
All fluid meshes must report Mesh OK
solver_checks: Successful termination or documented clean checkpoint
No NaN, nonphysical density/temperature or fatal errors
Record nonlinear residuals separately from linear-solver residuals
Compare last two sampled target metrics; flag changes above 5 percent
Record exact discretized boundary flux balance, distinct from interpolated cutting-plane flux
Tracer-temperature relation consistent for low-Mach screening
sensitivity: At least still air and 1 m/s crosswind for the same four designs
Mesh refinement for baseline and promising concepts; flag changes above 10 percent
Mark model-choice failures; never rank using failed ideal-gas runs
limits: Source is prescribed and cannot predict vortex backpressure response
Adiabatic dry-air model; no human heat transfer or comfort prediction
Boussinesq linear buoyancy is an approximation over the 20 K source/ambient difference
Temperature transport neglects kinetic-energy recovery; near-jet static temperature is approximate
Target flux is cooling potential through a reporting region, not heat extracted from skin
